To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
service quality is a significant determinant of visitor satisfaction.
service performance, the circumplex model, and visitor satisfaction have a significant and positive relationship with each other.
the quality of festival service is a significant factor in predicting visitor satisfaction and that the circumplex model can be applied as an effective tool in predicting visitor satisfaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship of service performance and the visitor's satisfaction in a festival setting.
the relationship between service performance, visitor's affect, and satisfaction in the festival context.
the relationships between service quality, affect, and visitor's satisfaction in the festival context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the service performance of the flower blossom festival was perceived as good by visitors, and that this perception of service performance was associated with the visitor's level of pleasure and the visitor's level satisfaction.
the higher level of service performance leads to a higher level of affect and satisfaction.
the service performance, the circumplex model, and satisfaction are positively correlated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
service performance is an important antecedent for visitor affect and that affect is also an antecedent for satisfaction.
service performance and affect are significant factors in determining visitor satisfaction.
festival managers should focus on the quality of service to improve the visitor's satisfaction and to enhance their pleasure and arousal.
The main takeaway from our work is that
service performance and affect are significant predictors of satisfaction.
the affective responses of pleasure and arousal are the key to understanding the relationship between service performance, and visitor satisfaction.
service performance and visitor satisfaction are positively related.
